title: Phantom Blade Zero Bosses by Class - 60 Story and Optional Fights
description: All 60 bosses in Phantom Blade Zero sorted by whether the story forces the fight or you can walk past it, with region and drop for each. Every name links to its own page.
keyword: phantom blade zero all bosses, story bosses, optional bosses, boss list

sections.title: How This Split Works
sections.content:
Phantom Blade Zero has 60 recorded encounters. The split below is not cosmetic: story fights come to you, optional fights do not, and the difference between a 20-hour run and a 40-hour one is almost entirely optional fights.

Class is taken from the encounter's role in the campaign, not from difficulty. An optional fight can be harder than a story one - see the boss guide for the colour tells that decide both.

sections.title: Why the Optional Fights Matter
sections.content:
Optional bosses are where the weapons are. Thirty-seven of the sixty encounters drop something, and the optional half of that list is where the distinctive builds live - the paired blades, the leg-mounted saws, the instrument.

They are also where the missable trophies are. Anything that can expire is listed on the missable page, and the drops are collected on what bosses drop.
